title: Requested, Executed and Recoverable Credit: Shared Action Ordering among LLM Borrowers in a Simulated Lending Market
abstract: arXiv:2610.15973v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We test whether shared action ordering changes executed credit in a simulated collateralized lending market. Three small open-weight language models face a borrowing cap that values collateral at the pool price; only two of the three model families traded. A validation campaign, hash-locked locally before its first model call, pairs 12 common-order markets with 12 balanced-order markets under a revised interface. An exact randomization test rejects the sharp null that common-market net debt is invariant to complete-order assignment (two-sided p = 2/8,100). The pre-specified estimate of the lever-up-first versus delever-first common-market contrast is 1.12 units of initial unused reference borrowing capacity, combining a 0.828 gap between the two groups of common markets with a 0.293 balanced-baseline component. translated_title: 请求、执行与可回收信贷：模拟借贷市场中LLM借款者的共享行动排序
translated_abstract: 我们检验在模拟的抵押借贷市场中，共享行动排序是否会改变已执行信贷。三个小型开放权重语言模型面临以资金池价格评估抵押品的借款上限；三个模型家族中只有两个实际进行了交易。一项验证活动（在首次模型调用前于本地进行哈希锁定）在修订后的接口下将12个共同排序市场与12个均衡排序市场进行配对。一项精确随机化检验拒绝了“共同市场净债务对完整排序分配保持不变”这一严格零假设（双侧p = 2/8,100）。预先设定的“先加杠杆”与“先去杠杆”共同市场对比的估计值为1.12个初始未用参考借款容量单位，由两组共同市场之间0.828的差距与0.293的均衡基线分量组合而成。所有24个市场均增加了债务。一项探索性会计分解显示，先加杠杆的共同市场借款更多且再……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过模拟抵押借贷市场实验发现，语言模型借款者之间的共享行动排序会显著影响已执行信贷规模，先加杠杆排序的共同市场比先去杠杆排序的市场产生更高的净债务。
en_tdlr: Using a simulated collateralized lending market, this paper shows that shared action ordering among LLM borrowers significantly affects executed credit, with lever-up-first common markets generating higher net debt than delever-first ones.
